purpose: Normalize Indian Ocean aviation for event-local adjudication without inventing exact serviceability. Combat aviation and ASW/patrol aviation are separated, with all cross-theater debits explicit.
interpretation_rules: Bands are branch planning bands, not exact historical rosters, unless an exact nominal count is explicitly identified as such.
Unknown is not zero; zero is used only where local absence is source/branch supported.
A unit cannot be credited simultaneously in the Indian Ocean and another theater. Named transfers override generic theater assumptions.
First-window packages require event-time weather, contact freshness, base/deck readiness and mission radius checks.
Search cue, maintained datum and weapon-quality contact are separate states.
ASW aircraft do not add to fighter/anti-shipping strike strength unless the specific aircraft and mission allow it.

window_posture.1944-02-19_21: Major operational squadrons are treated as shore-based/ashore at China Bay after exercises; immediate carrier-launched package before re-embarkation is 0.
window_posture.1944-02-22: 15 Wing Corsairs re-embark for Operation SLEUTH; Barracuda availability is event-time gated by embarkation/deck cycle.
window_posture.guard: Do not count shore sorties and carrier sorties from the same aircraft in the same time window.

Unicorn.capability_credit: Repair/maintenance, aircraft support and deck-landing practice may improve Eastern Fleet sustainment but do not create an extra strike group.

Battler.reason: Outside the Ceylon/Bay operational area in this window; no local sortie credit.

guards: Do not add all role sortie ceilings blindly; maintenance, weather and airfield cycles overlap.
Catalina/Liberator search can cue fleet action but is not automatically weapon-quality tracking.

role_anchor: 240 Sqn Catalina at Red Hills Lake
203 Sqn Wellington at Santa Cruz as radius-dependent support
No225_Group_Bay_support_subset.guard: Only aircraft within practical event radius and with mission tasking are credited; west-coast/remote 225 Group units are not automatically added.

Bengal_Arakan_No224_Group_branch_reconst.branch_state: Chittagong/Patenga is Japanese-held; British 224 Group elements and incoming units are treated as displaced/rebased north, not destroyed.
Bengal_Arakan_No224_Group_branch_reconst.included_branch_losses: British campaign aircraft writeoffs 40-55 and airfield displacement are already reflected in the broad band; do not subtract again.

IJA_5th_Air_Division.branch_state: Leans west toward Bengal/Arakan but is not wholly committed; Burma/Imphal support remains a competing requirement.
IJA_5th_Air_Division.Patenga_anchor: Late-Dec branch 15-25 fighter/recon presence is included inside the western subset, not additive.
IJA_5th_Air_Division.cross_theater_debit: Any use near Bengal reduces Burma/Imphal coverage and must be posted event-locally.

IJN_331st_Naval_Air_Group.branch_presence_rule: Retained in western network for this window because no dated branch transfer has been posted before the global frontier. Historical February Pacific transfer is treated as a divergence warning, not an automatic hidden move.
nodes: Port Blair/Car Nicobar detachments as tasking permits
IJN_331st_Naval_Air_Group.cross_theater_debit: If retained here, these aircraft/crews are unavailable to the Pacific. A later transfer requires a dated posting.

IJN_705th_Naval_Air_Group.window_presence: Credited in the Sumatra/Andaman search system for 1944-02-19..22. No earlier branch movement out is posted; historical transfer toward the Central Pacific occurs after this event window.
guards: Strike requires fresh weapon-quality contact, fuel, staging and escort/risk acceptance.
Do not simultaneously credit the unit at Truk/Palau before a dated transfer.

IJN_551st_Naval_Air_Group.reason: Twenty-six B6N2 Tenzan were ferried from Sabang via KAIYO on 1944-01-31 and reached Truk 1944-02-11; they cannot remain in the Indian Ocean ledger on 19-22 Feb.
IJN_551st_Naval_Air_Group.residual_guard: Do not invent residual B5N/B6N combat strength without a dated unit/base source.

carrier_air_commitment.mobile_seaplane_support: Chitose/Chiyoda remain option-only unless a dated movement is posted.
carrier_air_commitment.guard: Any commitment requires explicit Pacific opportunity-cost debit.

environment_and_C2.contact_state_rule: cue != track != maintained datum != weapon-quality contact
environment_and_C2.airfield_and_deck_damage: Apply only if a dated event posts degradation; do not silently carry generic damage forward.
environment_and_C2.night_operations: Night capability is role/unit specific and not inferred from daytime sortie bands.

Central_Pacific: 331 retained west means no simultaneous Pacific credit
705 remains west through this event window only; later transfer must be posted
551 Tenzan already debited from Indian Ocean and credited eastward
Burma_land_support: 5th Air Division western package is a subset, not additive to theater total
Allied: Illustrious shore and carrier aircraft are the same aircraft; no double counting across embarkation state

provenance.source_quality_note: External sources establish organization/location/nominal transfer anchors. Readiness and sortie values are intentionally broad branch planning bands, not claimed historical exacts.
